title: nan
authors: Yang Y.; Ma X.; Jiang Z.; Sun P.; Zhao X.; Xie Y.; Qian W.
key_contribution: Presents VSCM-Net, a VLM-guided cross-view matching and localization framework aligning UGV camera images with UAV-stitched maps in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
